DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • They activate Pillar of Frost or Empower Rune Weapon, as these cooldowns align with their burst windows
  • Their rotational cooldowns are synced for a major damage phase, especially during Obliteration or Breath of Sindragosa playstyles
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • The Deathknight’s Summon Gargoyle is active with less than 22 seconds remaining.
  • They use Army of the Dead alongside their Abomination (with less than 18 seconds remaining) or Army Ghouls (with less than 18 seconds remaining).
  • Dark Transformation is active and they lack major summon talents like Gargoyle or Army of the Dead.
  • Their Summon Gargoyle is unavailable for the full duration of Power Infusion (cooldown won’t align).
  • Facing 3+ enemies during Dark Transformation or while standing in Death and Decay.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They are in Metamorphosis (their major offensive cooldown), as this synergizes with their burst window.
  • The encounter will end in 20 seconds or less, ensuring the full duration is utilized before combat concludes.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their core cooldowns are ready (cd_condition) and they do not have the Keeper of the Grove (TWW Season 3 4PC) tier set active.
  • They have the Keeper of the Grove (TWW Season 3 4PC) tier set and their Celestial Alignment/Keeper of the Grove timing condition (kotg_ca_condition) is met.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • Bloodtalons is active (bs_inc buff), enhancing their combo point efficiency.
  • They are not using the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent, prioritizing consistent burst windows without major self-cooldowns.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active and the Evoker has Shattering Star on cooldown, the Shattering Star debuff applied, or there are two or more enemies present.
  • The encounter will end within 35 seconds to ensure the buff is fully utilized.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The Hunter has Trueshot active with more than 12 seconds remaining on its duration.
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds, ensuring a final use of Power Infusion before combat concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active with over 7 seconds remaining and Power Infusion is not active.
  • The Hunter does not have Coordinated Assault talented and Spearhead’s cooldown is off cooldown.
  • The Hunter has neither Coordinated Assault nor Spearhead talented.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • The Arcane Mage has just cast Arcane Surge (immediately after their global cooldown finishes).
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not currently active on them
  • The mage has Combustion active with more than 6 seconds remaining on its duration
  • OR the fight will end in less than 25 seconds (even without Combustion active)
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • they do not have Power Infusion currently active.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • The Windwalker Monk has Xuen the White Tiger active.
  • Either Bloodlust is not active, or if Bloodlust is active, Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active
  • Dark Ascension is active
  • The Shadow Priest has the TWW 4-piece tier set equipped
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • The Rogue's Deathmark damage-over-time effect is currently active on the target, as this aligns with their primary burst window.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They have Shadow Dance active, as this enhances their burst window by amplifying high-damage ability usage.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • The Shaman has Ascendance active, enhancing their burst window.
  • The Shaman’s Ascendance cooldown has more than 30 seconds remaining, ensuring availability aligns with their next major cooldown cycle.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • They have Deeply Rooted Elements talented and their Ascendance buff has more than 7.5 seconds remaining.
  • They do not have Deeply Rooted Elements and Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds is active.
  • The fight will end within 20 seconds of a 2-minute window (burst window alignment).
  • Their strongest cooldowns will not be available for at least 120 seconds.
  • They have no major cooldown talents selected (no Ascendance/Feral Spirit/Doom Winds).
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • The Warlock has activated Summon: Soulkeeper (their Soul Rot window) to amplify burst damage.
  • The Warlock is stacking Darkglare with other major cooldowns for a damage peak phase.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • The warlock's Wild Imp Swarm is about to despawn within the next 6 GCDs plus cast time, ensuring maximum benefit from their empowered attacks during this window.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Infernal is currently active to amplify burst damage during its duration.
  • The Warlock did not talent into Summon Infernal, allowing flexible usage outside of Infernal windows.
  • The encounter will end before another Summon Infernal cooldown becomes available (and shorter than 15 seconds after its next potential cooldown).
  • The remaining fight duration is too short to wait for Summon Infernal’s cooldown but longer than Power Infusion’s duration to avoid wasting it.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • Colossus Smash is active on the target and the fight will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • The target is in Execute Phase (below 20% health) and the warrior has Avatar active.
  • The fight will end in 25 seconds or less.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has more than 15 seconds remaining AND the encounter will last at least 135 seconds longer.
  • The target is in Execute Phase (below 20% health) AND Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds or less.
